description: Convert a URL, OpenAPI document, or HTML page into an OpenAI-style function spec for LLMs (POST /v1/tools/wrap). Stdlib-only fetch + parse.
name: tool_wrap
provider_notes: No external provider; fetches the target URL with stdlib urllib (10s timeout) and parses OpenAPI/HTML heuristically. auth_token is validated but never stored, logged, or returned. Demo runs against monkeypatched fetch, clearly labeled.
